# Family File Library Guide

Welcome to the **Android TV Family File Library** system.

## Key Capabilities

- *Secure Device Pairing*: Scan QR or enter 6-digit code.
- *Indic Regional Languages*: Native Malayalam and Devanagari text rendering.
- *Resource Protection*: 50MB storage limit and 500MB local cache ceiling.

> The system is designed to run within free-tier constraints while maintaining high performance.

```text
TV Remote Mapping: DPAD_LEFT = Prev Page, DPAD_RIGHT = Next Page
```
